scientific_integrity: The base finite-field ETF Gram construction is prior work; the new claim is the exact four-column spectral census and strict sharp deviation comparison. Finite checker tests do not replace global proof.
scientific_limitations: Only prime p ≡ 3 mod 4, p ≥ 7 and this unaugmented nonzero-quadratic-residue harmonic frame; no larger sparsity order or all prime powers. Possible older equivalent tournament spectral formulation, no independent priority certification.
title: Four-column spectral census and sharp distortion of Paley harmonic frames
